development_path.explanation: Your path starts after a few more calls.

limitations: This is Sales Xray's reading of your calls. It can change when you add context.
Your reports show where a skill came up. They don't prove why, or that you have mastered it.
Your focus is worked out from your saved calls each time you open Coaching.

mastery.explanation: Mastery means doing the skill well in real moments, more than once. Your reports don't count those moments yet, so no mastery level is shown. More calls are not the same as mastery.

pattern.summary: Your calls don't show one skill to work on yet.

regression.action: We need more calls on this skill to tell whether it is slipping.

root_cause.hypothesis: We don't have enough evidence yet to say why this happens.

limitations: Counts are report suggestions. They don’t prove a repeated mistake.
Totals never name a rep or show their calls, quotes, focus or mission.
A rep appears by name, with their current focus, only after they share. They can stop at any time, and any change to their membership ends it.
Owners and admins of the organisation see these totals.
